product_metadata.title: iDesign BPA-Free Plastic Bathroom Suction Toothbrush Holder - 2.75" x 2.25" x 2", Clear
features: HANGING TOOTHBRUSH ORGANIZER: Holds up to two toothbrushes to keep them off the countertop and within reach by the sink or in the shower
OPEN DESIGN WITH SUCTION CUP ADHESION: Open design allows items to dry more efficiently after use, while the included power lock suction cup maintains a secure hold in wet or dry conditions
EASY INSTALLATION: Simply lift the locking mechanism and push the suction cup into place for a powerful hold on most smooth surfaces including glass, tile, fiberglass, and some metals
MADE WITH DURABLE BPA-FREE PLASTIC: Durable BPA-free plastic construction stands up to every day use and is easy to clean with mild soap and water
COMPACT SIZE: Measures 2.75" x 2.25" x 2" and is ideal for use in compact spaces in the bathroom
description: Upgrade your bathroom storage with the iDesign Power Lock Suction Toothbrush Holder. This hanging organizer holds up to two toothbrushes to keep them off of the countertop and within reach by the sink or in the shower. The open design provides proper airflow and allows items to dry more efficiently after use, while the included power lock suction cup maintains a secure hold in wet or dry conditions. Simply lift the locking mechanism and push the suction cup into place for a powerful hold on most smooth surfaces including glass, tile, fiberglass, and some metals. Featuring a modern transparent design, this versatile organizer matches a variety of decor styles. The durable BPA-free plastic construction stands up to every day use and is easy to clean with mild soap and water. Measuring 2.75" x 2.25" x 2", this hanging shower caddy is ideal for use in compact spaces in the bathroom. With iDesign by InterDesign, you can #LiveSimply every day.
